examples.description: RED bottom and sides, HADAMARD on top.

examples.description: ZXX faces with K_SOUTH_WEST=true, K_SOUTH_EAST=false. Demonstrates all three is_y_defect states.

examples.name: Blue pair (east-west)
examples.description: Two all-BLUE cubes joined east-west via OPEN. Degenerate (ZZZ) — surfaces an unsupported-pattern toast.

examples.name: Red pair (east-west)
examples.description: Two all-RED cubes joined east-west via OPEN. Degenerate (XXX) — surfaces an unsupported-pattern toast.

examples.name: ZXX memory pair
examples.description: Two ZXX-memory cubes merged east-west via OPEN. Lattice-surgery merge along the X axis.

examples.name: XZZ memory pair
examples.description: Two XZZ-memory cubes merged east-west via OPEN. Opposite-basis counterpart of zxx_memory_pair.

examples.name: ZXX time evolution
examples.description: Two ZXX cubes stacked along K (time) sharing an OPEN face. piper-draw can't model the ZZO seam pipe — surfaces an unsupported-pipe toast.

examples.name: Hadamard pipe
examples.description: Two ZXX cubes joined east-west via a HADAMARD pipe (basis change between qubits).

examples.name: Port I/O pair
examples.description: Two ZXX cubes stacked along K with PORT on outer faces. Same ZZO seam pipe limitation as zxx_time_evolution — surfaces an unsupported-pipe toast.

examples.name: Disconnected pair
examples.description: Two ZXX cubes at non-adjacent coordinates — no edge, no pipe.
